name: On-screen display
description: Short overlay on a change of volume, microphone, brightness, keyboard layout or (opt-in) Caps/Num Lock: PipeWire, backlight and Hyprland events, no polling

volume.description: Show the OSD when the default sink volume or mute changes

brightness.description: Show the OSD when the backlight changes

backlight.description: Device under /sys/class/backlight; empty = the first one

mic.description: Show the OSD when the default source (microphone) volume or mute changes

layout.description: Show the OSD when a keyboard switches layout (Hyprland activelayout event)

lockKeys.description: Show the OSD when Caps Lock or Num Lock changes. The default binds.lua calls `haseen shell ipc osd lockkeys` on a release of either key, which reads `hyprctl -j devices` once
